title: Craterwake
pitch: Wind-up tin tanks duel across the Saltpan Twins. Ride each shell across the water, bore through enamel cover, and drop Rivet’s island into the sea.
controls: Drag or A/D to turn, ↑/↓ for angle and W/S for power. Pick ammo with 1–4 and fire with Space or Enter.

title: Nap Patch
pitch: Tuck sleepy bush critters into a patchwork quilt: one per patch, row and column, and no bumping. A daily quilt, plus an endless Quilt Trail of freshly stitched puzzles with five quilt patterns and sewn-on buttons.
controls: Tap to cross out, tap again to tuck in a critter, or long-press to tuck in one go; drag to cross out lots. Arrows move, Space, X, Enter, Z undo, H hint.

title: Piece by Pixel
pitch: Rebuild pixel-art postcards one piece at a time. Ten scenes, four tiers each.
controls: Drag pieces onto the outline; tap a piece to turn it; pinch or scroll to zoom.

title: Tumbleverse
pitch: Smash endless generated towers, castles and tiny planets. Unlimited ammo, gravity powers, ranks to climb and a daily demolition.
controls: Tap or click to fire, hold to keep firing; side buttons for powers and Next; two fingers or right-drag to orbit.

title: Loose Ends
pitch: Untangle porcelain shapes wrapped edge to edge in arrow cords. Endless levels, a daily puzzle, and boards of 200 cords.
controls: Tap a cord to pull it; drag to turn; pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers to slide; hold to preview. Undo, hint and zoom buttons.

title: Jewel Swap
pitch: Lift a handful of jewels, then let the rest flow home in a chain reaction. A new picture every day, an endless Journey, and jewel cuts to earn.
controls: Tap a group of jewels, then the tray or a matching socket; Flow sends home everything that can go. F flow, H hint, R restart, Ctrl+Z undo.

title: Shiftworks
pitch: Draft one machine a shift, drop it beside a winding conveyor and out-earn a quota that keeps climbing. A new factory floor every run, a daily shift and five grades to climb.
controls: Tap a card, tap a glowing cell, start the shift. Tap a machine to inspect or upgrade it; 1×, 2× or 4× speed.

title: Block Loop Shooter
pitch: Place limited-ammo colour shooters to drain a bead loop without stranding slots.
controls: Drag shooters to slots; 1–5 place, R restart, M mute, S speed, Esc levels.
